select `name`, `id` from `users` where exists (select * from `roles` inner join `model_has_roles` on `roles`.`id` = `model_has_roles`.`role_id` where `users`.`id` = `model_has_roles`.`model_id` and `model_has_roles`.`model_type` = 'App\Models\User' and `roles`.`id` in (2)) order by `name` asc
